_note: Static, hand-maintained table. Rules change; every entry says verify. Add passports by adding a top-level key.

TH.status: Visa-free (tourist stay up to 60 days); Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) required before arrival

VN.status: e-Visa required (about USD 25, up to 90 days); apply online before travel

ID.status: Visa on Arrival or e-VOA (about IDR 500,000), 30 days, extendable once; Bali also charges a tourist levy

MY.status: Visa-free up to 30 days (current exemption window); Malaysia Digital Arrival Card (MDAC) required

SG.status: Visa required for Indian citizens (apply via an authorised agent or the ICA e-Visa route); SG Arrival Card within 3 days of arrival

LK.status: Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA) required; free-visa scheme for Indian passport holders has applied in recent periods

AE.status: Visa required unless you hold a qualifying US/UK/EU visa or residence; e-visa via airline or ICP portal

MV.status: Free 30-day visa on arrival for all nationalities; confirmed accommodation and return ticket needed; IMUGA form

NP.status: Indian citizens do not need a visa; carry passport or voter ID
